description: A React component implementing a file upload UI with categorized upload cards, preview of uploaded files, and LinkedIn connect toggle. This component manages local UI state without external API calls.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string with appropriate units.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns the file extension label in uppercase or 'FILE' if no extension.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Provides display labels for upload categories.

methods.name: categoryHint
methods.description: Provides hint text for supported file formats per category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the string of accepted file formats for input element.
